# Arc 24 — comms-hygiene substrate DNA

Parent epic for arc-24 build. Bundles three tickets surfaced 2026-05-12 from the ariadne PLINY confabulation incident + the subsequent architectural-mechanism discussion (Monitor as canonical orchestrator transport, bw as canonical cross-tier substrate, asymmetric two-way comms via heartbeat-and-read-before-write):

- **stoa--odh** (P2) — Subagent status via bw substrate: universal heartbeat + read-before-write discipline (**LOAD-BEARING** for the asymmetric comms model)
- **stoa--nvl** (P2) — Orchestrator background-dispatch hygiene: Monitor + bw-poll bridge + tool-loading + TaskOutput-forbidden-on-Agents
- **stoa--ioy** (P2) — Confabulation-under-uncertainty discipline: "uncertain, checking" over assertion

## Directive

substrate/arcs/arc-24-build-directive.md (committed to the-stoa main with this epic). Four Phases × one gauntlet × ~20-30 substrate-prose deliverables across ~12 files. Builds on the-stoa main at Arc 23 ship commit (TBD).

## Architectural decisions LOCKED pre-dispatch

11 A-decisions in the directive (A1-A11). odh's discipline is load-bearing; nvl + ioy slot alongside. INCOMPLETE / UNVERIFIABLE verdict shapes (landed by Arc 23) inherited as the framework Arc 24's own verifiers use. CAPTAIN inventory taken at dispatch time (A6). Authorship attribution immutable.

## Sequencing

**DO NOT DISPATCH UNTIL ARC 23 (stoa--pmp) CLOSES.** Arc 23's ADA build phase edits substantially overlapping substrate files (operating-disciplines.md + every CAPTAIN role file + MAJOR_PLINY.md + MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md). Two ADAs editing the same files concurrently on different feature branches → merge conflicts on whichever lands second. Arc 24 dispatches against post-Arc-23 main so it inherits Arc 23's verification-complexity framework as part of its base.

## Comms

PLINY runs in autonomous mode with radio-check protocol per substrate/operating-disciplines.md §7. POLYBIUS polls the Arc 24 epic; PLINY heartbeats every ≤30 min unless surface-and-wait-blocked. PRINCIPAL is exception-handler.

## Self-referential note

The discipline this arc builds IS the discipline this arc uses. CAPTAINs dispatched in Arc 24 read the *new* version of their own role files (which carry heartbeat-and-read-before-write) during verification. Worked example of substrate updating itself in flight.

## Build session

Dispatched to MAJOR_PLINY_the_stoa via the activation paste at HUMAN_paste-pliny-arc-24-instruction.md (committed alongside this directive). PRINCIPAL fires the paste in a fresh Claude Code session AFTER Arc 23 ships.

Phase 1 — DAEDALUS surfaced integrated design at agents/design/arc-24/design.md (1073 lines, 14 sections). Verdict: PASS with 5 self-flagged weak points + 3 residual questions for ARGUS.

DAEDALUS-picks resolved:

- A7 scope: narrow scaffold update to agent-author skill (future CAPTAINs inherit discipline)
- A8 poll-loop: inline in MAJOR_PLINY.md §5.8; MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §7.6 cross-refs (single source of truth, drift defense)

2. Self-referential property novel at substrate-tier (defense: §10 worked-example framing)

Dispatching ARGUS for cold audit.

Surfaced 2 LOAD-BEARING defects already: jq not installed on this Windows env (Git Bash); bw JSON schema uses {text,timestamp} not {author,timestamp,body}. Continuing audit on wording-consistency contract + self-ref framing + remaining risk classes.

Identified third LOAD-BEARING defect: §8.11 wording-consistency contract is internally inconsistent with the actual §8 per-CAPTAIN prose (VERA + ADA carry parenthetical extensions on read-before-write; VERA carries 'or peer CAPTAINs' phrasing; ADA varies 'spawned poll-loop' vs 'spawned process'). Also surfaced: §11 probe-numbering inconsistency (p22-p31 and p23-p32 overlap; total math '37' inconsistent with sum). Finalizing verdict.

ARGUS verdict: REVISE: 4 load-bearing risks (canonical poll-loop has wrong JSON schema; jq not installed in deployed env; §8.11 contract internally inconsistent with §8 prose; §11 probe-numbering math wrong). Returning.

Phase 1 — ARGUS verdict: REVISE. 4 load-bearing risks:

R1 (LOAD-BEARING): Canonical bw-poll-loop template in design §3.1 Step 3 + §6.1 §5.8.3 references nonexistent JSON fields (.author, .body). Actual 'bw show --json' schema is {text, timestamp} only — no author field, comment text is 'text' not 'body'. ARGUS verified empirically against stoa--cm3 comments. Template ships broken — every Monitor notification fires with empty interior, silently breaking the upward-push half of the asymmetric comms architecture the arc is designed to ship.

R2: jq not installed on Windows Git Bash deployment (which: no jq in PATH). Compounds R1 — template wouldn't even reach JSON-parse step. Recovery shape (jq install vs python-based template vs --json sans jq) DAEDALUS picks.

R3: §8.11 wording-consistency contract is internally inconsistent with §8 prose the design itself authored. VERA (line 550) uniquely includes 'peer CAPTAINs'; VERA + ADA (lines 550, 652) uniquely add parenthetical extensions; ADA (line 656) uniquely says 'poll-loop leaks' vs 'process leaks' elsewhere. Contract violation before ADA types a character.

R4: §11 probe-numbering has duplicate IDs (p22-p31 and p23-p32 overlap) + arithmetic errors (§11.5 claims 35 probes summing to 34 visible IDs, grand total claims 37 but math is 46 if each per-CAPTAIN row counts as 10).

Non-findings discharged (clean): A6 inventory (10+2 confirmed), §17→§18/§19 placement, all 10 CAPTAIN insertion-points, MAJOR insertion-points, Monitor v2.1.98 web-cite verified, authorship A11 immutable clean, confabulation irony surface defended, self-referential framing defended, A8 cross-ref trade defended, 60-min N=1 calibration discharged. DAEDALUS §13 residual Q2 answered yes.

Phase 1 — DAEDALUS revision-r1 complete. All 4 ARGUS risks addressed:

Probe p44 expected-output updated. Rejected alternatives documented (jq-as-substrate-dep + non-JSON parsing).

Rewrote §8.11 contract distinguishing strict-verbatim paragraphs 1-5 (mechanical CATO diff) from named-slot template paragraphs 6-11 (slot-fit check). Lost-nuance items moved to §18 cross-refs.

R4: Renumbered probes p1-p46 consecutive unique. Corrected §11.5 summary with explicit per-row ID enumeration + arithmetic-check paragraph.

Authorship A11 Denson Smith immutable. 5 §13 weak points unchanged. Three new residual questions for ARGUS re-audit (slot-boundary precision; python-portability blind-spots; p44 falsifying-evidence sufficiency).

Dispatching ARGUS for re-audit.
